traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As a Magic action, you touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The creature regains a number of Hit Points equal to the total rolled. (1/Long Rest)

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you can transform for 1 minute (Choose: Heavenly Wings, Inner Radiance, or Necrotic Shroud). Extra damage equals your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. (1/Long Rest)

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon (Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver, White).

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line. Damage 1d10 (scaling). Dex Save for half. Uses: Proficiency Bonus/Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes. Fly Speed equal to your Speed. (1/Long Rest)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense (60ft) for 10 minutes while on a stone surface. Uses: Proficiency Bonus/Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf. Grants cantrip at level 1, spell at level 3, and spell at level 5.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Long Rest takes 4 hours of meditation. Magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: Choose Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion, Speak with Animals) or Rock Gnome (Mending, Prestidigitation + clockwork devices).

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose Cloud (Teleport), Fire (Extra Fire Damage), Frost (Cold Damage + Slow), Hill (Knock Prone), Stone (Reduce Damage), or Storm (Thunder Reaction). Uses: Proficiency Bonus/Long Rest.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Bonus Action to become Large for 10 minutes. Advantage on Strength checks, Speed +10. (1/Long Rest)

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: Advantage on saves to end Grappled. Count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: Move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: Gain an Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary HP (Proficiency Bonus). Uses: Proficiency Bonus/Long or Short Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead. (1/Long Rest)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal. Grants resistance and spells at level 1, 3, and 5.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip.
